source_weights._comment: Per-mention contribution. Higher = stronger signal. Tune by raising weights for sources you trust more.

convergence_multiplier._comment: When a topic appears in N or more DIFFERENT source types, score is multiplied. Counters monoculture (single-source loud day) and rewards cross-source agreement.

breadth_thresholds._comment: Lowered 2026-06-03 from 15/20 alongside BREADTH_PLAN actor-attribution. Removing publishers + contrast co-mentions shrinks every topic's org set, so the old 15/20 floor (set against the inflated distribution) would almost never fire. After the first corrected radar run, read breadth_audit.median_breadth_30d and re-tune: high_breadth_7d ~= top-third of the NEW distribution, very_high ~= top-quartile.
